title: Catalog Description
text: Introduction to Python programming with an emphasis on problem solving, algorithm development, object-oriented programming, and software engineering fundamentals. Intended as a first college-level course for transfer-oriented Computer Science pathways, students develop computational thinking and structured program design skills. Students design, implement, test, debug, and document software solutions using variables, control structures, functions, collections, file processing, exception handling, and classes. Emphasis is placed on algorithmic problem solving, professional programming practices, maintainable software development, and the effective use of AI-assisted development tools. Laboratory instruction includes program development and testing.
